1.consolidated_definition: Entrenar los gallos, traquearlos, adiestrarlos para el deporte gallístico. Algunos galleros los trabajan dos veces en semana. Otros, una vez. Ponce.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Train cockerels, toughen them up, train them for the sport of cockfighting. Some roosters are worked twice a week by some galleros, while others are worked once a week in Ponce.
